en.text:
Kills while Transcendent spawn up to 4 Orbs of Power for allies that grant 7.15?% Super Energy.

Orbs spawn upon passing specific point thresholds: 30, 50, 70, and 100 points for each orb.

Points gained per Kill by <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 10 points
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 15 points
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 20 points
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites: 34 points
• T4 Elites, Minibosses: 40 points
• Bosses: 50 points
• Players: ? points
